HPX_SHORTCUTS.py.summary: This class provides a comprehensive automation flow for managing HPX Shortcuts within the Android application. It supports operations such as creating, editing, deleting shortcuts, and configuring destinations for print, email, and save actions. The class also handles scan settings and validation of shortcut configurations, ensuring robust test coverage for shortcut-related features.
